items.title: Bootstrap Arca with Conditor: Praxis 3.7.2, Ordo 1.5.0, Communication Engineering 1.0.0 from echelon-current 1.2.0, plus the fsharp-nuget-library scaffold (foundations, build-and-test, release workflow)
items.description: Establish everything the ecosystem expects of a new package repository through Conditor (conditor.json, Registry authority echelon-current 1.2.0 linux-x64 sha256 ea1b39a0..., lifecycle components and the fsharp-nuget-library scaffold added by conditor#52 and conditor#53). No product code: the library is the scaffold placeholder.

items.title: Derive Arca's storage requirements from Signal, Chrona and Summa, record the decisions, re-anchor the charter, and capture the dependency-ordered backlog
items.description: Write docs/requirements/ARCA-STORAGE-REQUIREMENTS.md, deriving Arca's requirements from Signal (ADM-*, AER-*), Chrona (CHX-*) and Summa (SUM0-*, SUM3-*) and citing their IDs. Record DF-ARCA-2026-0001 (GitHub only behind a storage interface, pure core plus adapter, WASM, no Fides dependency) and DF-ARCA-2026-0002 (per-deployment data location, application-owned namespaces, separate repositories per permission boundary, no at-rest encryption). Replace the boilerplate charter and context. Capture slices in build order (the minimal slices before Chrona's storage). Add a test that every requirement is named by an open work item.

items.title: Arca slice 1: package layout - pure core and GitHub adapter packages, WASM-safe, Aegis-bound (ARCA-ARCH-001..007)
items.description: Minimal slice, needed before Chrona's storage work (build order: Arca and Fides minimal slices -> Chrona -> Summa -> rest). Requirements: docs/requirements/ARCA-STORAGE-REQUIREMENTS.md ARCA-ARCH-001..007, decisions ARCA-D-001..006. Split the scaffolded EchelonFoundry.Arca into a pure core (no I/O, clock, randomness or browser access; effects as data) and an EchelonFoundry.Arca.GitHub adapter (OQ-ARCA-002, recommended). Prove that both build and run in the .NET browser-WASM runtime that Limen hosts. Bind Aegis for operational failures and reuse EchelonFoundry.Aegis.Integration.GitHub's failure model. No Fides reference (ARCA-D-002). Functional style. Acceptance: an architecture test fails if the core references System.Net, System.IO file APIs, DateTime.Now or Random. A WASM smoke test loads both assemblies. Foundations verify passes with Aegis required.

items.title: Arca slice 2: per-deployment data location, app-owned namespaces and path safety (ARCA-LOC-001..010)
items.description: Minimal slice. Depends on WI-0003. Implements the user's decisions ARCA-D-005 and ARCA-D-007 (DF-ARCA-2026-0002). The location (owner, repository, branch, base path) is configured per deployment and never hard-coded. Each application owns its namespace and never assumes it owns the repository or the root. Each application can point at its own repository or a shared one; a permission boundary means a separate repository, because GitHub permissions are per repository, not per folder. Per-organization sub-namespaces carry immutable ids. Discovery is deterministic, through manifests. Environment identity and repository visibility are exposed (public-repository refusal hook). Path traversal and writes outside the namespace are refused. No at-rest encryption (ARCA-LOC-010). Acceptance: property tests show that no generated path escapes its namespace, two applications configured against one repository never collide, and a location change is refused outside the migration workflow (ARCA-LOC-009).

items.title: Arca slice 3: canonical JSON record format, stable ids, manifests and schema versioning (ARCA-REC-001..007)
items.description: Minimal slice. Depends on WI-0004. Canonical JSON encoding (equal content gives equal bytes and equal hash), one record per object or event, deterministic partitioned paths, stable internal ids, the application manifest and the dataset/organization manifest, per-record schema versions with explicit refusal of unsupported versions, authoritative and derived data kept separate by type and path, and external artifact references. Acceptance: round-trip and canonicalization property tests, plus golden vectors.

items.title: Arca slice 4: optimistic concurrency, conflict detection, three-way merge and commit/audit format (ARCA-CON-001..004, ARCA-COMMIT-001..006)
items.description: Minimal slice. Depends on WI-0005. Pure core: expected-revision preconditions; typed conflicts that list the changed records; a three-way merge in which independent additions commute and same-record edits are reported as semantic conflicts, never auto-resolved; one logical operation as one atomic multi-record change set; a deterministic commit message and trailers (namespace prefix, actor kind human/agent/service/integration, actor id, execution id, correlation id, idempotency key); no tokens or business content in metadata. Acceptance: property and model-based tests for determinism, commutativity and no lost update.

items.title: Arca slice 5: token-provider port, identity resolution and capability snapshot (ARCA-AUTH-001..005)
items.description: Minimal slice. Depends on WI-0003. The token-provider abstraction (a function that yields a token or a typed failure: none, expired, revoked) is the only way credentials enter Arca, so there is no Fides dependency (ARCA-D-002); Fides supplies an implementation (Fides FID-CLI-001). Resolve the acting identity from GitHub. Derive a non-secret capability snapshot (read, write, branch writable, archived, visibility) and revalidate it after errors. Refuse a credential that resolves the location to a different repository identity. Never persist tokens. Acceptance: tests show that tokens never appear in any serialized output, commit, queue entry or fault.

items.title: Arca slice 6: GitHub adapter - atomic commits, conditional requests, rate limits, OutcomeUnknown and idempotency (ARCA-API-001..005, ARCA-OUT-001..002, ARCA-COMMIT-001/006)
items.description: Minimal slice; the last one Chrona's storage work needs. Depends on WI-0006 and WI-0007. Uses the Git data API (blobs, tree, commit, then a conditional ref update) so one operation becomes one atomic commit against an expected base. Uses ETag conditional reads and caches immutable objects by hash. Observes rate limits (remaining budget, reset, retry-after) with exponential backoff and jitter and no spinning. Pages and batches, with no repository-wide scans. Reports a typed OutcomeUnknown and reconciles it by inspecting state before any retry, keyed by the idempotency key. Detects protected or archived branches and fails explicitly. Runs over Limen Http in the browser.

items.title: Arca slice 7: provider conformance suite, in-memory provider and real-browser WASM verification (ARCA-TEST-001..004)
items.description: Depends on WI-0008. A shared conformance suite (round-trip, conditional write, CAS, concurrent modification, idempotent repeat, OutcomeUnknown reconciliation, missing and corrupt objects, unsupported capability, pagination, rate limit, oversized object, auth failure, read-only, stale change token) that both the GitHub adapter and an in-memory provider pass. The in-memory provider ships for consumer tests. The adapter is verified in a real browser through Limen (Playwright). Telemetry and faults carry ids only.

items.title: Arca slice 8: storage content is untrusted input - validation, manual-edit and tamper detection (ARCA-INT-001..004)
items.description: Depends on WI-0005 and WI-0008. Validate everything read: path, size, canonical encoding, schema version, content hash, dataset/namespace identity and type. Detect manual edits made outside Arca (hash changes, commits without Arca trailers) and unexpected modification of records declared immutable, and leave room for a later hash chain. Refuse writes when validity cannot be established (integrity before availability).

items.title: Arca slice 9: offline change queue as data with durable browser persistence through Limen (ARCA-OFF-001..006)
items.description: Depends on WI-0006 and WI-0008. Needed by Chrona's offline timer and entry (CHX-230). Pure queue model (ordered entries, idempotency keys, base revisions, states pending/in-flight/synchronized/conflicted/outcome-unknown), observable sync state, and reconnect reconciliation that never discards either side. Offline writes are opt-in per application; Signal uses read-only degraded mode instead. Persistence goes through Limen interop. Limen 0.7.x has no IndexedDB capability (OQ-ARCA-003): request one from Limen, and use Limen Storage (localStorage) behind the same port until it exists.

items.title: Arca slice 10: rebuildable derived indexes, explicit migration workflow and canonical export (ARCA-MIG-001..003, ARCA-LOC-009)
items.description: Depends on WI-0010. Derived indexes record the authoritative source set they were built from and can be validated, rebuilt and compared. Versioned, resumable, idempotent migrations (schema and location: validate, copy, verify, activate; the source stays untouched until explicitly retired). Canonical export for backup and escape hatch.

items.title: Arca first release: interim distribution as Sigstore-attested GitHub release assets, echelon-registry entry, Conditor local-feed install; nuget.org Trusted Publishing kept dormant until NUGET_USER exists
items.description: DF-ARCA-2026-0006 and docs/distribution-short-term-plan.md. Release both packages (EchelonFoundry.Arca.Core, EchelonFoundry.Arca.GitHub) as attested GitHub release assets, register them in echelon-registry, make Conditor install them into consumers from the release assets through a local feed, and keep the nuget.org push dormant until the NUGET_USER repository variable exists.

items.title: (Deferred, possible future) per-application at-rest encryption for co-located data
items.description: Not a requirement. The user decided on 2026-10-08 (ARCA-D-007, DF-ARCA-2026-0002) that there is no at-rest encryption for now: permission separation uses separate repositories per permission boundary. This item records the possible future option (b): per-application keys, possibly through Aegis, as an explicit provider capability. Key custody and rotation, keys never stored beside ciphertext, explicit lost-key state, and canonical hashes unchanged (SIG ADM-025). Do not start without a new user decision.

items.title: Align Arca to echelon-current 1.3.0 (conditor upgrade --current) and regenerate the test project as a real xUnit dotnet test project (conditor#54)
items.description: User direction 2026-10-08: align to echelon-current 1.3.0 via conditor upgrade --current, and regenerate tests/Arca.Tests as the conditor#54 xUnit scaffold, porting the requirements traceability check to xUnit facts.

items.title: Limen IndexedDB adapter for Arca's offline queue-store port (ARCA-OFF-002) in a new EchelonFoundry.Arca.Limen package, replacing the interim localStorage adapter (Limen LCP-046, LCP-059, LCP-060, LCP-062, LCP-065)
items.description: DF-ARCA-2026-0005, DF-LIMEN-2026-0005. Requirements: kemiller2002/limen docs/requirements/LIMEN-INDEXEDDB-REQUIREMENTS.md LCP-046, LCP-059, LCP-060, LCP-062, LCP-065, LCP-068, LCP-070, LCP-072, LCP-073. Blocked on Limen WI-0166 (Limen 0.8.0 releasing EchelonFoundry.Limen.Contract and EchelonFoundry.Limen.Store as attested release assets, installed through Conditor) and on Arca WI-0019 (queue-store conformance). Placement: a new package EchelonFoundry.Arca.Limen referencing Arca.Core and Limen.Store only; Arca.Core and Arca.GitHub take no Limen dependency. Implements the unchanged QueueStore port over limen.store: one queue owner per namespace through a coordination-pack lock with a fencing epoch compared by putIf (a pre-empted owner's Save writes nothing and fails as Unavailable; non-owner tabs get OwnedElsewhere from the factory, outside the port) - this removes the whole-snapshot last-writer-wins loss that two tabs can cause with the localStorage adapter today; FIFO and exactly-once hand-off (only the owner runs OfflineSync; recover then reconcile in-flight entries); a durability-mode composer (IndexedDb, LocalStorage, MemoryOnly) that reports the mode it obtained; LocalQueueLost when the database is found recreated after the device held a queue; sign-out clearing per the application's sharedDevicePolicy (ask | discardOnSignOut); QueueDiagnostics (mode, depth by state, snapshot size against budget, last save, last sync, ownership). Passes WI-0019's suite over Limen's fake and in Chromium and WebKit. The localStorage migration is WI-0020; the read cache is WI-0021/WI-0022. The core does not change.

items.title: Release Arca 0.2.0 (slices 7-10) as attested GitHub release assets and register it in echelon-registry
Namespace-scoped change tokens: condition a commit on the application's own namespace, not the whole repository
items.description: Requested by Chrona (DF-CHRONA-2026-0005, coordinator decision 2026-10-08). ARCA-CON-005: a change token scoped to one namespace (the Git tree SHA of the namespace root on the data branch), so in a repository shared by several applications (ARCA-LOC-002/003) another application's commit neither marks this application's read cache stale (Limen LCP-084) nor fails its conditioned write; same atomicity and OutcomeUnknown semantics; conformance proves a concurrent change inside the namespace is refused while one outside it is not; the repository-wide token remains only as an explicit fallback (DF-ARCA-2026-0011).

items.title: Queue-store port conformance suite: one executable contract that the localStorage, in-memory and (later) IndexedDB QueueStore implementations all pass (ARCA-OFF-002; Limen LCP-046, LCP-060, LCP-075)
items.description: No dependency; can start now. Arca's QueueStore port has implementations (LocalStorageQueue, the tests' memory store) but no shared conformance: add one in Arca.Core beside the provider conformance (Conformance.fs), as data-driven cases over a subject that yields a fresh QueueStore: save/load round-trip with order and sequences preserved (property over queueGen), absent queue loads None, a foreign namespace's queue is Corrupt, over-budget save is QuotaExceeded with nothing truncated, unavailable storage is Unavailable, and a fault the harness cannot arrange is Unsupported, never passed. LocalStorageQueue and an in-memory store pass it now; the IndexedDB adapter (WI-0016) must pass it. Requirements: kemiller2002/limen docs/requirements/LIMEN-INDEXEDDB-REQUIREMENTS.md LCP-046, LCP-060, LCP-075; DF-LIMEN-2026-0005.

items.title: One-time move of the localStorage queue into IndexedDB: idempotent, drain-then-adopt, safe at every interruption point (ARCA-OFF-002, ARCA-MIG-002; Limen LCP-066, LCP-067)
items.description: Depends on WI-0016. In EchelonFoundry.Arca.Limen: when the queue owner first opens a namespace with IndexedDB available, move the arca.queue.<app>[.<dataset>] localStorage snapshot into IndexedDB exactly once: decode with LocalStorageQueue.loaded (corrupt or foreign: left in place, LegacyQueueUnreadable); if the IndexedDB queue is empty, putIf the queue with a migration marker (SHA-256 of the localStorage text), read back and compare, then remove the localStorage key; if the IndexedDB queue has entries, defer (LegacyQueuePending) and adopt only once it is empty - never merge, never drop; a marker equal to the text's digest means only the removal remains. Copy, verify, retire (DF-ARCA-2026-0008). Fault-injection test per cut point over Limen's fake, and one real-browser tab-close test. The core does not change.

items.title: Read-cache port in Arca.Core: Cached and Fresh values, token-stamped partitions, freshness rules, an in-memory implementation and a read-cache conformance suite (Limen LCP-082..LCP-086)
items.description: No dependency; can start now. Chrona's offline-start read cache (coordinator 2026-10-08), generic for Summa (SUM0-015) and Signal (ADM-055, ADM-070). Pure, no I/O (ARCA-ARCH-001): a cache entry keyed by account, namespace and partition carries the change token it reflects, every record's content hash, the record schema version and the read time (an input); validation as ARCA-INT-001; Cached<'T> is a distinct type from Fresh<'T> and no write-building function accepts a Cached value or token (compile-failure fixture); revalidation rules (equal token confirms, different token refreshes or marks stale, missing partition removes); clearing by account and by namespace under the application's sharedDevicePolicy (ask | discardOnSignOut: the cache is cleared at sign-out under both). Holds only provider-read data, never unsent changes (ARCA-OFF-006). Requirements: kemiller2002/limen LCP-082..LCP-086; DF-LIMEN-2026-0005 section 4.

items.title: IndexedDB read cache in EchelonFoundry.Arca.Limen: compound-keyed partitions, online revalidation, policy-driven clearing, budget and least-recently-used eviction (Limen LCP-082..LCP-087)
items.description: Depends on WI-0016 (the Arca.Limen package and its Limen.Store consumption) and WI-0021 (the port). Implements the read-cache port over limen.store: entries keyed [account, namespace, partition]; revalidation reads only shown partitions' change tokens (namespace-scoped tokens once WI-0018 lands); deleteRange for sign-out and clear-this-device; a per-namespace budget with LRU eviction; a failed cache write never fails the read and never takes space the queue needs; any tab may write the cache (whole provider-validated partitions). Passes the read-cache conformance suite over Limen's fake and in Chromium and WebKit. Requirements: kemiller2002/limen LCP-082..LCP-087.

items.title: Cross-reference Limen's IndexedDB requirements (LCP-043..087, DF-LIMEN-2026-0005) from Arca's requirements and backlog plan; refine WI-0016 and capture WI-0019..WI-0022
items.description: Docs and queue only, no code. ARCA-OFF-002 and OQ-ARCA-003 point to kemiller2002/limen docs/requirements/LIMEN-INDEXEDDB-REQUIREMENTS.md and DF-LIMEN-2026-0005; the backlog plan lists the IndexedDB items in dependency order; the whole-snapshot two-tab hazard of the localStorage adapter is recorded.

items.title: Fix multi-tab loss in the interim localStorage offline queue: two tabs saving one whole snapshot lose entries (last save wins); single owner per namespace behind the unchanged QueueStore port (Limen LCP-059, LCP-060, DF-LIMEN-2026-0005)
Release Arca 0.2.1 (multi-tab localStorage queue fix) as attested GitHub release assets and register it in echelon-registry
Release Arca 0.3.0 (EchelonFoundry.Arca.Core, .GitHub and the new .Limen: IndexedDB queue, migration, read cache) as attested GitHub release assets and register it in echelon-registry
items.description: Ships WI-0016, WI-0019, WI-0020, WI-0021, WI-0022 at 0.3.0, the new package at the same version. Then echelon-registry: releases/arca/0.3.0.release.json and echelon-current 1.11.0. Consumers: Chrona WI-0059 and WI-0057.

items.title: Move Arca's build from limen-fsharp 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 through Conditor (echelon-current 1.12.0); re-verify the queue, read cache and Limen vectors
items.description: echelon-current 1.12.0 selects Limen 0.9.0 and limen-fsharp 0.9.0. conditor upgrade --current with the 1.12.0 linux-x64 resolved set (sha256 d6a26a57...) moves only limen-fsharp for Arca's declared components; vendor/nuget, Directory.Packages.props, the authority and lock follow. The store library is expected byte-identical; re-run the full suite and the browser verification.
